t: This large detached house in the south west corner of the Royal Hospital Chelsea grounds was built in the nineteenth century as Gordon House. Thomas Leverton, an English architect, designed it for Colonel James Willoughby Gordon. After Gordon died in 1851, it became part of the Royal Hospital. In 2012 Christian Candy bought it, and his brother Nick Candy renamed it Providence House and renovated it, adding a huge basement. In 2026 it sold for two hundred and seventy-five million pounds, the most expensive house ever sold in the UK.
